metadata.case_name: NG KONG v. GOLDEN CATERERS LTD

plaintiff.education_level: secondary school education in the mainland

source: The joint medical report of the Plaintiffs and the Defendants doctors showed that the Plaintiff suffered from a sprained back injury.
The present condition of Ng is that the back injury of sprain is now over 2 years. There are some residue subjective back pain and stiffness and left leg pain. There is also some subjective weakness.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.body_part: lower back and left lower limb
source: He was diagnosed to be suffering from sciatica.
The Plaintiff main problem was left sciatica.
On 21 August 2002 the Plaintiff was admitted ... because of persistent low back pain and numbness and weakness of his left lower limb.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

source: The MRI test conducted at Queen Mary Hospital and Princess Margaret Hospital revealed that the Plaintiff had been suffering from degeneration of multiple discs and these discs generation was a natural occurring condition of wear and tear and was not caused by the accident.
I accept the evidence of Dr. Cheng (the Defendants doctor) that the degenerative condition was a pre-existing condition.

manifestations.description: residual subjective back pain and stiffness
tenderness at the lower left paraspinal muscles
flexion of the spine was limited
limitation of straight leg raising of his left lower limb
numbness and weakness of his left lower limb
walking and sitting tolerance about 30 minutes
